description: Header file defining the FirmwareUpdateImplementation class, which implements firmware update and configuration interfaces for a plugin in the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and internal structures related to firmware update operations.

classes.name: FirmwareUpdateImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing firmware update and configuration interfaces, managing firmware update processes, notifications, and threading.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Nested class representing a dispatchable job for firmware update events, managing reference counting and dispatch logic.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a firmware update notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a firmware update notification callback.

methods.name: UpdateFirmware
methods.description: Initiates firmware update with specified file path and type.

methods.name: GetUpdateState
methods.description: Retrieves the current firmware update state.

methods.name: SetAutoReboot
methods.description: Enables or disables auto reboot after firmware update.

methods.name: startProgressTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer to track firmware update progress.

methods.name: flashImage
methods.description: Flashes firmware image from server URL with specified parameters.

methods.name: flashImageThread
methods.description: Performs firmware flashing in a separate thread.

methods.name: dispatchAndUpdateEvent
methods.description: Dispatches firmware update events with state and substate.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the provided shell.
